references.text: A similar command in the war against Jabesh Gilead, where virgins were spared while others were killed
The laws of war in Deuteronomy describing the treatment of women and children in conquered cities
Israel's destruction of Sihon and his people, including men, women, and children
A similar action against Og, king of Bashan, where all inhabitants were killed
The destruction of Jericho, where everything living was devoted to destruction
Saul's command to completely wipe out the Amalekites, including women and children
The context of the verse: Israel killed all male Midianites in the war
The background for the punishment: Midianite women led the Israelites into idolatry
